scope: Local implementation, gameplay verification and OPEN diagnostics only; no canonical training, sealed evaluation, certification or promotion
immutable: all pre-existing sources, worlds, rewards, experts, artifacts, entry points and dirty changes

difficultyMechanics.rescue: rooms, keys, team roles, supplies, civilian deadlines and patrol/hazard pressure
difficultyMechanics.cards: categories/ranks, deck redundancy, clues, errors and partner uncertainty
difficultyMechanics.factory: recipe depth, capacity, power allocation, congestion, construction delay and disruption
difficultyMechanics.roguelike: dungeon size, campaign depth, inventory scarcity, enemy variants and stale-memory challenges

informationBoundary: Authoritative kernels stay on Node server/evaluator; new controller worker accepts only immutable allowlisted packets. Browser receives fixed viewer perspective, public metrics and sanitized traces. No private seed/RNG/future/hidden-state hash. Legacy games use explicitly identified unchanged compatibility wrappers, not new hidden-information qualification.
cardPerspective: Browser viewer P0 never switches perspective when partners act; each partner privately receives its own permitted packet. Public partner traces contain action/parameters only, not private rationale/beliefs.
actionContract: Offered attempts derive from observed/public facts; hidden outcome correctness is resolved by step. Binding includes version, actor, tick, observation and full action-set hashes. Invalid/stale external proposals rejected without state advance; explicit rule-policy fallback on expert abstention only.
replays: Public observation/action hash-chain replay excludes seed, private initial state and evaluator metrics; verifies public integrity only. Privileged evaluator replay permits exact deterministic regeneration offline and is never served by browser endpoints.
feasibility: Bounded generator retries; connected/resourced layouts with verified evaluator-only successful witnesses where available. Structural checks explicitly distinguished from optimality and information-constrained solvability. Card feasibility is full-deck reachability, not a guarantee a limited-information team solves it.

budgets.scope: No authoritative simulator successor API in controller module; observable/public models only. Per-decision latency and actual work counters recorded.

populations.seedRule: base + worldIndex*100000 + difficulty*1000 + replicate; same world seed across compared controllers; no ancestor reserved seed reuse
populations.familyRule: replicate parity chooses declared procedural family A/B; both represented equally; known-family replication, not structural OOD
populations.unit: episode; roguelike campaign; paired same-seed controller comparisons; no turn-level pseudo-replication
populations.weights: unit episode/campaign, equal scheduled quotas; report every generation rejection and timeout; never impute missing utility zero

diagnostics.cards: Main uses 2 players and fixed RULE_BASED partners; separate contract fixtures cover 2/3/4 players and all partner policies; OPEN partner-shift panel is supplemental and separately labeled
diagnostics.roguelikeMemory: Main uses CAMPAIGN_MEMORY; OPEN matched memory panel uses first 5 seeds per difficulty, same BOUNDED_PLANNER policy and budget under all 4 memory modes; fresh per-campaign state and frozen empty starting experience corpus
diagnostics.information: Costed scouting/clues/inspect logged; no scientific VOI from tile counts. Policy-matched full-episode acquisition controls only if causally qualified; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED.
diagnostics.statistics: episode/campaign paired bootstrap 2000 fixed-seed resamples, exploratory 95% intervals; not multiplicity-controlled certification; report rates, counts, means, quality and catastrophic outcomes together

metrics: Per-world metrics have versioned operational definitions; evaluator truth excluded from controller feedback. Gameplay return is separately declared and never scientific DDV. Belief Brier scores only for explicit predecision hypotheses with supported truth/time; unavailable FPE/CAD/CR/DDV/TCA/VOI/TCA are null/NOT_ESTABLISHED.
acceptance: All four new worlds genuinely playable at D1-D5; existing four accessible unchanged; independent state; explicit success/failure/timeout; exact replay; hidden-state input equivalence; conservation and action legality; actual manual and auto-play in desktop and small real browser. Negative diagnostic rankings are allowed; missing gameplay or boundary violation blocks completion.
freeze: After DEV repair and software/browser verification, exclusively save exact source closure and parameters before any OPEN outcome. No retuning after OPEN; failures/weaknesses retained. Changed candidate requires separate authorization/version/untouched population; no automatic cycle.
termination: Stop after build, verification and registered diagnostics, or report a precise blocking boundary. No external publishing. No later intelligence stage. Do not overwrite prior results.
